# apollo/enrich

A built-in enrich adapter for person records: it needs `apollo.id` and provides 17 fields. Plan estimates $0.0100 per record, and it demands `APOLLO_API_KEY`.

## Manifest

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| id | `apollo/enrich` |
| version | 1 |
| role | enrich |
| entity type | person |
| credentials | `APOLLO_API_KEY` |
| cost estimate per record | $0.0100 |
| freshness | 30 days (the default `cache:` window) |

## Needs

```json
{
  "properties": {
    "apollo.id": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "apollo.id"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## Config keys

The keys `with:` accepts. Plan rejects any other key.

| Key | Type | Required | What it sets |
|---|---|---|---|
| `base_url` | string |  | Override the API host (testing) |
| `reveal_personal_emails` | boolean |  | Ask Apollo to include personal emails (their flag; off by default) |

## Example

From [See it run](/start/show-me):

```yaml
  - id: reveal
    use: apollo/enrich
    when: fit.passed
    cache: 30d
```
